title: Pretreatment Prognostic Nutritional Index Predicts Progression-Free Survival in BCLC Stage C Hepatocellular Carcinoma Treated with Sorafenib.
caption: Kaplan–Meier curves for progression free survival (PFS) according to albumin bilirubin (ALBI) grade. Worsening ALBI grade was associated with shorter progression-free survival. Detailed survival data are provided in  Table 3 .
context: Kaplan–Meier curves for progression free survival (PFS) according to albumin bilirubin (ALBI) grade. Worsening ALBI grade was associated with shorter progression-free survival.
